findings.reason: as written the node is not implementable (the mechanism cannot run on the real code path without first recording the follower's host), so the author must name where the host comes from or state that the registration gains one.
findings.text: §4's deliverable ("a registration made on another host is not judged gone from this host's process table") needs to know the registration's host, but the follower registration record writes no host key (cited evidence: archive §3, follower_registration.py:296-307), so at the liveness read the producer cannot distinguish a foreign registration from a dead local one, and the fix silently requires a new data source the section never names
